must_haves: Flexibility to adapt to feeding and nap schedules
nice_to_haves: Willingness to engage in play and educational activities
parents.notes: We are first-time parents looking for a nanny to help care for our 6-month-old baby girl. Both my partner and I work hybrid schedules, going into the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and need someone reliable to care for our little one on the days we are home. We are feeling quite anxious about leaving her with someone new, as this is our first experience with childcare outside of family. It’s important for us to find someone who is not only CPR-certified but also has experience specifically with infants, as we want to ensure our baby is safe and well cared for. We would prefer a nanny who understands the unique needs of a young child and can follow her feeding and nap routines. We would love a caregiver who can also engage her in age-appropriate activities to support her development. Ideally, we are looking for someone who can communicate openly with us about our baby's progress and any concerns that may arise. We do not have any pets, so allergies should not be an issue. We would appreciate someone who is patient and can help ease our worries as we navigate this new chapter in our lives. Thank you for your assistance!

parents.notes: Hello! We are the Martinez family, and we are looking for a reliable and caring nanny to help us on Saturday mornings. Our family consists of two children: our 7-year-old daughter, Sofia, who loves to play games and engage in creative activities, and our 2-year-old son, Mateo, who is still napping during that time. We would like a nanny who speaks Spanish to help expose our children to the language, as it is important to us that they develop bilingual skills from a young age. During the hours we need coverage, we would like the nanny to engage with Sofia in age-appropriate activities while also ensuring that Mateo gets his nap time. If the nanny can help prepare a light brunch for the children, that would be a bonus, but it's not a requirement. We live in the Eastside area and would prefer someone local who can commute easily. Our dog, Luna, is very friendly and would need some attention as well, so being comfortable with pets is a plus. Thank you for considering our family! We look forward to finding the right match.

must_haves: NICU or postpartum experience strongly preferred
Ability to provide basic infant care including feeding, diapering, and soothing
nice_to_haves: Familiarity with infant sleep training techniques
parents.notes: We are expecting our first child in three months and are seeking a night-nurse or newborn-care specialist to help us during those crucial early weeks. Since this is our first experience with a newborn, we want someone who can guide us and provide reassurance as we navigate this new chapter. We are looking for assistance three nights a week, ideally from 8 PM to 8 AM, so we can get some rest while knowing our baby is in capable hands. It's important that candidates have NICU or postpartum experience, as this would give us peace of mind in case any unexpected situations arise. We would appreciate someone who is compassionate, patient, and has a calm demeanor. Additionally, if they have experience with breastfeeding support or infant sleep training techniques, that would be a bonus for us as new parents. We live in the Eastside and would prefer a nanny who is local or has reliable transportation. Please include references from previous families in your application. Thank you for your help in finding the right fit for our family!
